mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE signals aggressive monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks intensify.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market deterioration
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS down and UNRATE up) fails to predict negative SPX 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending gains momentum.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases despite UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicate strengthening consumer demand for housing, correlating with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as residential construction contributes to economic growth.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to predict positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% YoY), rising residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion gains traction.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 YoY > 0.5%, RSAFS growth fails to predict positive SPX 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals consumer-driven economic recovery offsetting manufacturing weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and INDPRO down) fails to predict positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.
